name: Identity, Settings, Contacts, Organizations, Locations
foundation_dependencies: LLD-08 SiteDispatchAddressProvider for site-derived current Dispatch Location address
scope: singleton Local User Profile identity + descriptive display_name metadata
Customer Organization identity/lifecycle/external Account Code claims
not_owned_here: generated/exported operator artifacts -> owning consumer packets; LLD-02 provides bounded reference/contact/address data only and never writes or publishes files
transaction_boundaries: Every authoritative LLD-02 mutation follows LLD-01 command ordering and uses one outer UnitOfWork; receipt, reference/lifecycle writes and required audit evidence commit or roll back together.

Pure normalization, field-bound validation, match-key calculation and read-only previews occur outside the writer transaction; revision, lifecycle, uniqueness, conflict and dependency eligibility are revalidated inside it.
Customer Account Code reviewed shared-claim/reassignment commands bind to an exact review_snapshot_hash and recompute it inside the authoritative UnitOfWork.
CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite and CreateLocalUserProfileIdentity are internal shared-UoW participants; they never commit independently from the LLD-08 or LLD-12 coordinating command.

Local User Profile display_name edits are standalone LLD-02 metadata commands: they revalidate the singleton metadata revision and never mutate LLD-12 password/session/auto-login/security revision or encryption authority.
Settings defaults are read-only code-defined values; persistence occurs only through WriteSetting and never as a side effect of reading a default.
failure_modes: reference target is missing, archived or stale for an operation requiring active current state
Customer Account Code conflict/review state changed or reviewed source/target ownership cannot be re-proven
Contact channel is invalid, not owned, archived or ambiguous for the consuming purpose
archive/reactivation dependency owners report blockers or indeterminate validation
registered matching profile or SettingDefinition contract cannot safely interpret persisted/requested values
field/collection bounds fail rather than truncating
Local User Profile display-name edit with stale metadata revision or conflicting replay fails without changing actor/security authority
any receipt/domain/audit failure rolls the entire authoritative UnitOfWork back
semantic NO_CHANGE preserves revisions and does not fabricate lifecycle/audit history
review_evidence: A prior packet-local semantic/authority review corrected Customer Account Code coverage, deterministic Unicode matching, duplicate-code authority overreach, channel semantics and preserved history provenance.

A prior packet-local implementation/security review corrected receipt/FK ordering, semantic NO_CHANGE replay, bounded archive guards, exact reviewed-conflict freshness binding, O(1) writer-lock validation, STRICT schema enforcement, FK child indexes, Settings handling, multi-channel ambiguity, SQL/cursor safety and shared-code reassignment edge cases.

Pass-1 correction removes the stale required username model: local_user_profiles persists only immutable actor/profile identity plus editable descriptive display_name, first-run defaults it server-side, and password-only authentication remains exclusively LLD-12 authority.

V2 retrofit adds explicit transport DTO names, security policies, stable error surfaces, privacy-minimized audit payload contracts, packet migration allocation, lifecycle transition matrices and exact operation-module destinations while preserving approved semantics.

Machine traceability is split into bounded command/query fragments beneath a requirement/cross-packet root index; the final integrity stage independently proves the same closure fields before accepting a split representation.

Route policy and auxiliary routes are split from the root transport registry; the final integrity stage actively validates declared route fragments for manifest membership, byte budget, duplicates, handler/type/error resolution, canonical prefix, auth and request bounds.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; the corrected Pass-2 source passed the strengthened whole-repository gate with zero findings.
design_principle: Reference identity is immutable and reusable; descriptive equality produces candidates only, Local User Profile display_name is descriptive not login authority, lifecycle preserves history, reviewed conflicts bind to exact current state, and cross-domain dependencies are validated through owned bounded interfaces inside the same UnitOfWork.
